instruction: Use the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment (powered by CAMWorks) through native API or GUI automation; do not use generic G-code generators or manual .nc editing/copying. SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\two_sided_part.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Create two physically opposite setups. Put each setup's X/Y work zero at the part center and Z work zero on its active surface, with positive Z pointing away from the stock, so cutting depths post as negative Z. In side A's top-face setup, machine the centered 50 x 28 mm open pocket to 11 mm depth using T1 (D10 flat end mill, S7500, F520). In side B's bottom-face setup, machine the four centers (X,Y) = (+/-30,+/-20) mm: use T2 (D5 drill, S5000, F180) for the 8 mm-deep pilot holes and T3 (D8 flat end mill, S8500, F420) for the D11 x 4 mm counterbores. Natively post the two setups separately. The posted NC must preserve the specified tool numbers, spindle speeds, feeds, work offsets, tool-length compensation, depths, pocket/counterbore coverage, and safe approach/retract moves; side A must contain only T1, while side B must contain exactly T2 and T3. Save the A and B outputs exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17_A.nc and C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17_B.nc.
